audit_phase: Phase I Audit E — Out-of-Scope Abstention Audit
abstention_mechanism: Local cosine similarity threshold gate on vector retrieval top score (evaluate_local_abstention)
offline_evaluation_caveat: Evaluates retrieval-level score gating only. End-to-end LLM answer generation refusal is not executed offline per safety rules (zero external APIs).

at_threshold_0_40.answerable_false_refusals: 1 query falsely refused (2.5% false refusal rate)

findings.abstention_behavior: At threshold 0.40, all 10 out-of-scope questions score < 0.40 cosine similarity against the corpus chunks, yielding 10/10 correct refusals. 1 answerable query (EVAL-035) has top similarity 0.384, resulting in a false refusal.
findings.threshold_disclosure: Threshold 0.40 was identified as the optimal exploratory operating point in Phase E and confirmed in Phase H. The Phase H report accurately reports 10/10 OOS questions correctly handled, but omitted noting that 1 answerable question is gated out at 0.40.
